__broaden__.μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε · also fem. gen. sg., governed by εἰδότε: ’skilled in all (fighting)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἔσχοντο: ’from the fighting’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντιβολῆσαι: ’to meet (the battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of place, with ἐπ’ ἀριστερά: ’on the left of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀδαήμονι: ’ignorant of (battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐξαποδίωμαι: ’out of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἔργον: ’of battle’ (ἔργον … μάχης ’work of battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on νίκην: ’victory of battle’ (μάχης νίκην) · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντήσειε: ’meet (in) battle’ (μάχης ἀντήσειε ’would meet in battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἄρχε: ’(begin) the battle’ (ἄρχε μάχης ’begin the fight’) · also fem. gen. sg., object of παυσώμεσθα: ’cease from battle’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with σχήσεσθαι: ’from battle’ (or governed by μεμαώς: ’eager for battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀπέληγε: ’from (the fighting)’ (ἀπέληγε μάχης ’left off the fighting’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἐπιτάρροθοι: ’helpers in battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., after ὄπισθε: ’behind the fight’ (ὄπισθε μάχης) · also fem. gen. sg., of respect after ἀκόρητοι: ’insatiate of battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἐπύθοντο: ’learned of the fighting’ · also fem. gen. sg., after postpositive ἄπο: ’away from the battle’ (μάχης ἄπο ’away from the fight’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on πόνος: ’toil of battle’ (μάχης πόνος)

__broaden__.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’ · also εἰς ὅ κέ + fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ σ’ … ποιήσεται ’until he makes you’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (καί κέ τις … ἐρέει ’someone will say’) · also ὄφρά κέ + subj.: ’until’ (… κέ … ἐνείκω ’until I bring’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so … might’ · also with an aor. indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κέ τοι … φάνη ’there would have appeared to you’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κέ τίς … ἀτιμήσειε ’no one would dishonour’) · also εἴ κέ in an indirect question, + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj.: ’whether’ (εἴ κέ … ἀπώσεται ’whether he will thrust back’) · also εἰ … κέ + short-vowel subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ (εἰ … κέ σε … ἀπολύσομεν ’if we should release you’) · also εἰς ὅ κέ + long-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ … ἕληται ’until he takes’) · also + short-vowel subj. in a main clause: ’shall’ (ἐγὼ δέ κέ τοι ἰδέω χάριν ’I shall acknowledge the favour’) · also + pres. indic. in a main clause, generic: ’would’ (καί κέ τις εὔχεται ’any man would pray’) · also εἴ κέ + long-vowel subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ (εἴ κέ μ’ … συλήσωσι ’if … should strip me’)
